camera.note: three.js column-major 4x4; world units metres, y up; pixel = ((ndc.x+1)/2*w, (1-ndc.y)/2*h)

lights.name: screen
lights.kind: CRT screen (blue, area source); the BEAM (the light that matters)

lights.name: ceiling
lights.kind: bare incandescent bulb in a porcelain pull-chain lampholder under a joist (Jade, 2026-11-26), warm, ON: the room ambient

warnings: wrist: dad L beyond the wrist range (flexion +16 deg, ulnar deviation +46 deg, pronation +31 deg; flex 75.9, radial -75.8, twist -111.3, after an elbow swivel of 0 deg)
wrist: dad R beyond the wrist range (flexion +16 deg, ulnar deviation +46 deg, pronation +31 deg; flex 75.9, radial -75.8, twist -111.3, after an elbow swivel of 0 deg)
wrist: jade7 R beyond the wrist range (pronation +15 deg; flex 28, radial 5.8, twist -95.5, after an elbow swivel of 0 deg)
intent: Set reference: the whole basement from the front-right corner, over the two watermelons: the stair along the front wall (frame left), the desk standing free in the middle with Dad and Jade at it, the empty floor behind and left of it, the lally post at the desk’s back-right corner, the 1950s wringer washer beyond. The screen and the ceiling bulb light it.

beam.name: CRT screen glow
beam.model: area source (the screen rectangle), radiating into +z; frustum spreading by half_angle from the rectangle, faded out at range
beam.corner_order: TL,TR,BR,BL as the screen is read
beam.falloff: inverse-square from an area source: full on faces 0.4-0.6 m away, about 1/10 at 1.5 m

floor.note: the desk top cuts the light: floor nearer the desk than desk_shadow_ends_z, and everything under the desk, is unlit

eye_deg.note: eyes relative to the head; travel clamped to +-35 yaw, 30 up / 45 down
